# Adrian Treleaven

## Overview

- **Age:** Roughly thirty or thirty-five years old  <sub>[v4 c24 P6](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0006)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c22 P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019)</sub>
- **Origin:** Ontario  <sub>[v4 c22 P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019)</sub>
- **Role:** Journalist, author, and writer  <sub>[v4 c22 P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019), [v4 c23 P23](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0023), [v4 c24 P6](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

Adrian is described as tall and well-looking, possessing a broad-shouldered frame, dense brown hair, a sharp nose and chin, and expansive, luminous dark-gray eyes. He has a pleasant voice, a charming smile, and a good sense of style. At times he exhibits a distinct pallor and an unhealthy look.

_Sources: [v4 c23 P8](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0008), [v4 c24 P6](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0006), [v4 c26 P1](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0001)_

## Personality

Adrian is pleasant, intelligent, enthusiastic, and articulate, though he is occasionally given to grandiloquent speech. He readily inspires affection and trust in others, winning over people like Tabitha with his charm and warmth. He feels things deeply, expressing intense emotions when in love, and seeks private confidences when under emotional distress.

_Sources: [v4 c24 P6](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0006), [v4 c24 P7](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0007), [v4 c25 P14](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0014), [v4 c26 P2](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0002), [v4 c26 P25](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0025)_

## Goals

- To find a theme and write a successful book  <sub>[v4 c23 P23](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0023), [v4 c24 P6](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0006)</sub>
- To win the affection of and court Lorna  <sub>[v4 c26 P2](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0002), [v4 c36 P27](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0027)</sub>
- To gather material in Japan for his new novel  <sub>[v5 c2 P67](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0067)</sub>

## History

Adrian Treleaven traveled to the ocean at Seven Gulls on his physician's instructions after failing to fully recover from a severe spring bout of typhoid fever, desiring to visit the ancient homestead where his grandparents, the Tremaynes, had lived. Upon his arrival, he joined the Carrows and Lorna Vane in various summer activities across the harbor, rivers, and pastures, during which he worked on a book project. He fell deeply in love with Lorna, but left Seven Gulls at the end of the season after confessing his feelings to Nell Carrow. During his time there, he collaborated with James Garrick on a biography titled *The Life-Book of Captain Saul*, gathering material directly from Seven Gulls and taking a photograph of Captain Saul for its frontispiece. After the book was accepted for publication, he stayed in Vancouver before writing to request room and board to return to Seven Gulls to court Lorna. They eventually married and had a child, subsequently traveling together to Japan for a year to gather background material for Adrian's new novel.

_Sources: [v4 c22 P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019), [v4 c25 P14](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0014), [v4 c26 P2](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0002), [v4 c26 P19](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0019), [v4 c28 P35](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0035), [v4 c34 P30](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0030), [v4 c36 P27](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0027), [v4 c38 P1](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0001), [v4 c39 P5](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0005), [v5 c2 P67](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0067), [v5 c2 P68](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0068)_

## Background by volume

- Grandson of schoolmaster John Tremayne through his eldest daughter, Alice Tremayne  <sub>[v4 c22 P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019), [v4 c24 P22](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0022)</sub>
- Suffered a severe attack of typhoid fever during the spring  <sub>[v4 c22 P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019)</sub>
- Wrote short stories for various magazines while working for a newspaper  <sub>[v4 c23 P23](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0023)</sub>
